summary: Aya Gold & Silver Inc. furnished a Form 6-K containing its Q1 2026 earnings release, MD&A, and interim financial statements. The filing reports record revenue of $117M (up 247% YoY) and operating cash flow of $70M, driven by higher silver prices. There are no special-situation transactions such as acquisitions, divestitures, or capital returns. The board renewal announcement is a routine governance matter, not a forced change. This is an ordinary earnings report with no event triggering a special-situations classification.
